# Zierra Veon Hair & Beauty Studio

> Premium full-service unisex hair, nail, and skin aesthetic salon located in Malabe, Sri Lanka.

## Business Details
- Address: No. 757 / 28B, Kaduwela Road, Malabe, Sri Lanka
- Phone: +94 74 318 1001
- WhatsApp: +94 74 318 1001
- Operating Hours: Tue-Fri 10:00-21:00, Sat-Sun 10:00-19:00, Closed Mon.

## Primary Services & Starting Prices
- Gents Grooming: Haircut + Wash (LKR 1,500), Beard Trim (LKR 1,000), Full Grooming Packages from LKR 2,000.
- Ladies Haircare: Ladies Haircut (LKR 3,500), Blow-dry (LKR 2,500), Balayage (from LKR 25,000), Keratin Treatment (from LKR 25,000).
- Nails & Beauty: Express Manicure (LKR 1,500), Pedicure (LKR 3,000), Acrylic Nails (LKR 6,500), Eyebrow Threading (LKR 350).
- Skincare & Facials: Clean-ups (from LKR 2,500), Facials (from LKR 4,000), Hydra Facials (from LKR 10,000). Brands used: Ume Care, Kejo, Jovees, Derma Pro.
